items: Each area's wild swarm now grows steadily along the runestone order to about 12 at the last one, and every kind of animal is equally dangerous: strong kinds come as a few big ones, weak kinds as many small ones
Swarms mix young and adults wherever they can: mostly young near home, mostly adults far out
Soundsystems are much easier to knock down (500 health, from 4000): stop a swarm before it gets there
